content.title: Basic information on Czechia | Embassy of the Czech Republic in London
content.text: Czechia is a landlocked country in Central Europe. The country is bordered by Poland to the north, Germany to the west, Austria to the south and Slovakia to the east. Its capital and largest city, with 1.3 million inhabitants, is Prague. Czechia includes the historical territories of Bohemia and Moravia and a small part of Silesia. Flag and Coat of Arms: Political System Parliamentary democracy Time Zone: Continental European Time (GMT+1) Area: 78,864 sq. km Population: approx. 10 512 000 People: The Czechs with minorities of Slovaks, Poles and Germans.
